mentions.name: ProofLeague
mentions.description: ProofLeague is an iOS, Android and web app for keeping workout promises with friends. Users create a private league, set a weekly workout goal (e.g., working out 3x a week), and tap Start when beginning a workout. Friends get notified and have 30 minutes to request a selfie; if nobody asks, the workout counts automatically. There is no public feed or strangers involved — just a small group keeping each other honest. One selfie shared from a workout automatically goes to any league that asks. The app is free.
mentions.problem: Keeping workout promises with friends previously relied on ad hoc coordination via text messages; the app solves group workout accountability without public feeds or strangers.
mentions.audience: Friends and family keeping each other accountable in small private groups; free consumer app open to anyone setting up a league.
